messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" which translates to "How frequently did members visit the Museum of Contemporary Art last year?" They want the frequency of visits by members at the Museum of Contemporary Art last year.

We need to retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. But the question is about how frequently members visited. We might interpret as we need to find the most frequent visitor among members? Or maybe we need to get the average visits per member? The function only retrieves the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. It doesn't provide average or total visits. So we can call the function with museum_name: "Museum of Contemporary Art", start_date: "2023-01-01", end_date: "2023-12-31". That will return the most frequent visitor. Then we can answer accordingly.

But the user asked "去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？" They might expect an answer like "The most frequent visitor was X with Y visits." Or "Members visited on average Z times." But we don't have data for average. So we can provide the most frequent visitor and their count.

Thus we should call the function most_frequent_visitor with museum_name: "Museum of Contemporary Art", start_date: "2023-01-01", end_date: "2023-12-31".

We also might set minimum_visits: 1 (default). So let's call it.
